rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for retiring or being retired.

example.english: I plan for retirement at fifty-five.
example.traditional: 我打算五十五歲就退休。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 syun3 ng5 sap6 ng5 seoi3 zau6 teoi3 jau1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the portion of life lived after leaving work, rather than the act of leaving employment.

example.english: Their retirement life is very fulfilling, and they volunteer every day.
example.traditional: 佢嘅退休生活過得好充實，每日都去做義工。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 teoi3 jau1 sang1 wut6 gwo3 dak1 hou2 cung1 sat6 mui5 jat6 dou1 heoi3 zou6 ji6 gung1
